statement: A tenant id and an app id are each one path segment: neither holds '/' (ScopeResolver.isValidAppId, the rule of both, and SnapshotKey.Tenant and SnapshotKey.App with it). The resources the control plane authorizes on put the id between '/' (doc/tenant/<t>/..., scope/<t>/<a>/<s>), where a pattern's one-segment capture and a trailing ** would take a longer id for another tenant's. The principal that would cross is a platform principal: the hard rule (TenantIsolation) lets one act on any tenant, so for it the resource string is the only thing between tenants. A platform principal holding cosec:read on doc/tenant/acme and doc/tenant/acme/** (one tenant, delegated by resource pattern) reads tenant acme's document, and GET /documents/tenant:acme%2Fwest is 400 for it: no key names that tenant. ControlResources refuses '/' in a segment as a second line, so either line alone keeps the tenants apart. A token of such a tenant or app is an invalid credential (401 token-invalid, alike on every adapter); a forwarded identity of such a tenant is 400 invalid-request; a principal an authenticator answers in one is unresolved (503); a credential's declared app of one is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH). A stored record under such an id is an SCP-10 format error of the whole record, whose failure names the record and the id. cosec-migrate refuses such a tenant or app id at the id (SLASH_IN_ID), and an API key of such a tenant, and writes nothing.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#a tenant or app id is one path segment
control:OneSegmentTenantIdTest#an operator delegated one tenant reads no document of a tenant whose id extends it
runtime:OneSegmentIdPipelineTest#a token of a tenant or an app with a slash is token-invalid and reads no tenant's documents
runtime:IdentityGateTest#an identity whose tenant can be no tenant id is refused
runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a tenant id that cannot name a document is unresolved
migrate:ConverterTest#every rejection kind is reported with its location and nothing is converted
migrate:ConvertedDirectoryTest#an app id with a slash is refused, not encoded
migrate:MigrationRecoveryTest#a tenant id with a slash is refused, not planned
migrate:MigrationRecoveryTest#partition plan on the command line refuses a tenant id with a slash and writes nothing
migrate:ApiKeyMigrationTest#a key that cannot be converted exactly is refused
cocache:SlashIdRecordsTest#a back-reference set or a change of a slash id fails whole, naming the record and the id
cocache:SlashIdRecordsTest#a resident record of a slash id reads as that instance's unknown documents
